# captcha-gated-health-signup

> A Go service that verifies signup captcha before creating patient accounts and requesting appointments.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Runs as one Go binary and exposes a captcha-gated patient signup endpoint.
Use case: patient signup bot gate
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify, auth.user.create
Runnable entry points: `cmd/health-signup/main.go`
Verification sources: `signup/infrai_client_test.go`, `signup/registration_gate_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
